UserProfile.title: UserProfile
UserProfile.description: Authenticated AuraSound user identity profile stored privately per user.

displayName.description: Display name shown in cloud sync status.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp of last profile update.

CloudBackup.title: CloudBackup
CloudBackup.description: Cross-device backup snapshot containing player settings, EQ presets, playlists, smart playlists, track preferences, and daily recommendations.

ownerId.description: UID of the user who owns this backup.

settings.description: Player, theme, audio engine, and EQ configuration map.

smartPlaylists.description: Dynamic rule-based and AI smart playlists (max 50).

trackPrefs.description: Track favorites, 1-5 star ratings, play counts, and edited tags keyed by fingerprint (max 500).

/users/{userId}.description: Private user profile document keyed by Firebase Auth UID.

/users/{userId}/backups/{backupId}.description: User-owned cloud backup and sync snapshots (e.g., 'latest' or manual restore point).
